about_the_game:
Sundae Drive is a cozy job simulator where you run your very own ice cream truck in a charming, animal-filled neighborhood. Hit the road, pick the perfect spot, and serve up sundaes that are as cute as they are delicious!

🚚 Drive, Park, and Serve

Choose where to set up shop each day by exploring a colorful city map. Park strategically in busy spots, then switch to first-person serving mode to craft each order to perfection. Scoop ice cream, drizzle syrups, add toppings, and hand over the sweetest treats to your chibi animal customers.

🐾 Meet Adorable Customers

From bunny kids with a sweet tooth to gourmet owls with refined taste, every customer has their own quirks, preferences, and patience levels. Learn their favorite flavors, keep them happy, and earn extra tips for perfect orders.

🍨 Build Your Ice Cream Empire

Restock at the market each morning, manage your supplies, and upgrade your truck with faster scooping, bigger storage, and stylish new designs. Unlock new ingredients, discover rare flavors, and even create your own ice cream combinations.

🌞 A Day in the Life

  • Morning: Refuel and shop for fresh ingredients
  • Afternoon: Explore the map, park, and serve customers
  • Evening: Return to HQ, review your earnings, and plan your next route

✨ Features

  • Drive and park in themed zones like the Beach, Park, and School
  • Serve cute chibi animal customers in first-person ice cream crafting
  • Manage fuel, stock, and time for the best results
  • Upgrade your truck with new tools, storage, and cosmetic designs
  • Unlock new flavors, syrups, and toppings to expand your menu
  • Enjoy colorful 2D visuals and cheerful, jingly sound design

Climb into your colorful truck, turn up the jingle, and bring smiles to every corner of the neighborhood—one scoop at a time!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
